notes.title: Update 1.04 - Camera system rebuild!
notes.content:
New Update!

We finally did! we have just rebuild the whole camera system to prevent the strange collisions, low camera angles and full zoom to the Worshippers knees.

We have also improved the navigation paths at some points in different levels, so worshippers will move a bit more smoothly now.

Overall optimization has been done, and a few bugs has been sended to the hell.

Keep telling us your thoughts and ideas and we will keep improving this holy game!

notes.title: Update 1.03 and Mac version available!
notes.content:
Mac OS X users can now be blessed with the glory of the Savior!

Also, the game is updated to the 1.03 version! 

Major optimizations had been done for this update, and also we added a new difficulty selector menu in order to let players enjoy the narrative withtout worry about the extra hard levels, but do not be fooled!! heaven will be only for the bravest players!

Discover this and all the other new features in The Savior's Gang!

notes.title: Update 1.03 and Mac versions coming soon
notes.content:
The Mac version with a new update for The Savior's Gang will come this week!
We have added a difficulty selector and we did great improvements to the optimization of the game among other new features!

Stay tunned for the new update and the patch notes!

notes.title: First update! The Savior's Gang 1.01 Update is here!
notes.content:
Few days before our launch, and it's already here! we hear your thoughts comments and watch your gameplays and screenshots to find bugs and improve the game. We are still working on solving bugs and adding new features that you asked for, this is just the first update of many more.

-Box Update:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34481343/7c12e9e28726bb4a0c029eda89387e3339b6d5fc.gif[/img]
Worshippers move box faster, and they respond way better to your instructions at the moment of picking up the box!

-Menus - Setttings extended - exit button:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34481343/2f31a485ad37e3797abb39afc830d6c17de0a79a.jpg[/img]
We have added a video settings. Until now, we set this settings internally by an initial benchmark, now you can change it at your desire.
We have also added an exit button on the main page.

-Epitaph first update:
We ask for people to send the epitaphs they want to see in the game, we have added it on this update. But we will do more updates! so if you want to see new custom epitaphs tell us!

-Other bugs fixes:
Some balls get stuck on their path and the camera was vibrating continuously
Worshippers no longer flyes when they go through a wooden bridge
Some minor camera fixes
Optimization improvements

-Next Updates:
Difficulty level selector
Adding some checkpoints on some levels
More bugs solved!
Surprises!

notes.title: Your opinion is important !!!
notes.content:

Hi everyone! After the successful release of The Savior's Gang we want to improve the game to make this blessed experience even better! [b]REVIEW The Savior's Gang[/b] and let’s make this game greater all together !

notes.title: The Savior's gang is now available!
notes.content:
You will know the truth, take the control your worshippers are awaiting to your command!

Be carefull because the path is full of dangers, strange old gadgets, unnstable arcs, fallen trees, spikes, tar pits, insects, vulcanos... there are too many dumb ways to die in here, try to be safe, and watch out.

There are some super-entities that are trying to contact you via HolyApp, so take a look at your screen!

Savior bless you!
